<import java.util.Scanner;public class Main{public static void main(String[] args) {Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);int n = sc.nextInt();int b = sc.nextInt();int[] arr = new int[n];for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {arr[i] = sc.nextInt();}int even = 0, odd = 0;for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {if (i != 0 && even == odd) {int diff = Math.abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]);System.out.print(diff + " ");}if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {even++;} else {odd++;}}int count = 0;for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {if (arr[i] <= b) {count++;b -= arr[i];}}System.out.println(count);}}
